x: Ben Challenger is Britain’s sole high jumper and Goldie Sayers is our women’s javelin representative. Phillips Idowu was originally named to take part in the triple jump - subject to fitness - but has now withdrawn.
A third successive javelin title went to Goldie Sayers who although a little down on distance in this competition has thrown a lifetime best of 61.45 metres this summer.
